entries.title: C0041: 2026 solution claim requires proof audit
entries.statement: The 2026-09-07 C0041 intake recorded directional transience implying ballisticity for iid uniformly elliptic nearest-neighbor RWRE in d>=2 as an open conjecture after a bounded search. A manuscript dated 2026-09-23 now claims the exact implication as Theorem 1.1. As of 2026-10-10 this worker has not independently certified its main estimate or an actual formal proof. Track status as claimed resolution pending independent audit; do not treat the dated open label or the new claim as a final verdict.
assumptions: C0041 concerns a fixed direction under annealed almost-sure transience
This is a time-stamped source-status note, not a theorem

entries.title: C0041 proof gate: quenched crossing estimate
entries.statement: For C0041, almost-sure existence of directional regeneration cuts does not by itself give a finite mean time between cuts. The 2026-09-23 claimed proof uses a stronger input: for some epsilon in (0,1), the probability over iid environments that the quenched chance a_N of reaching height N before -1 is below N^(-epsilon) decays faster than every polynomial. Its derivation from directional transience alone is the main proof gate still requiring independent audit; only with a valid quantitative input does the time-tail reduction apply.
assumptions: Claimed route, not a certified theorem

entries.title: C0041 crossing route: retain the first-step factor
entries.statement: In a quenched path argument that first forces an upward step from y and then a height crossing from y+e1, the prescribed route has probability omega(y,+e1) times the conditional crossing probability, hence at least kappa times that crossing probability under uniform ellipticity. The finite-region visit-count consequence is drafted in the w446 audit and awaits w449 review. This local correction does not establish C0041.

relations.rationale: Both cards concern the exact C0041 implication; this status note dates the old card's no-resolution-found label and points to the later claimed proof.
The crossing estimate is the load-bearing unchecked input of the newly claimed C0041 resolution.
The first-step factor is needed in the proposed conversion from a quenched crossing lower bound to an exit-time tail.
